d:
Sal 2020 ke bihar vidhanasbha chunav men vamadlon ne behtar pradarshan kiya tha. in partiyon ne bihar men na keval siten jitin, balki rajy ke satta-samikran men bhi apni rajnitik upasthiti aur prabhav ko mazbuti se darj karaya tha. aise men ek bar phir ab bihar men vidhanasbha chunav ho rahe hain aur vamdal mahagathbandhan ke sath chunavi muqable men hai. aise men saval hain ki kya vamdal 2020 ke vidhanasbha chunav ki tarah is bar bhi behtar pradarshan kar paenge? unke samne kya chunautiyan hain? janie is graund riport men.
Riport: prerna
Shut: saptarishi
Edit: devesh chopra
